idea: Instagram reels editing for cafes near campus in Dehradun

strategist.problem: A cafe owner near campus has no reels for the week on Monday morning because nobody on staff can shoot and edit video, and footfall dips during the 4-7pm student rush.
strategist.target_customer: Owner of a 10-40 seat cafe within 3 km of a Dehradun college campus, spending ₹50,000-₹3,00,000 monthly, who sees students filming content but has no consistent Instagram output.
strategist.mission: We edit and deliver weekly Instagram reels for cafes near Dehradun campuses so owners get consistent content without hiring an editor.

competitors.name: Local Dehradun social media agencies
competitors.differentiator: They lock 3-6 month retainers at prices a single cafe cannot justify; we sell month-to-month to one cafe at a time.

competitors.name: Freelance editors on Fiverr and Upwork
competitors.differentiator: We shoot on-site at the cafe in Dehradun and know the campus crowd, so turnaround is same-week with no timezone lag.

competitors.name: A nephew or junior handling Instagram for free
competitors.differentiator: They post twice then stop; our fixed weekly reel delivery keeps the feed alive through exam weeks and holidays.

scope_cuts: No custom scheduling or analytics software — we deliver MP4 files and captions via WhatsApp and Google Drive.
No photo shoots, branding, logo or website work — reels only, so a solo founder with 15 hours a week can deliver.
No hiring editors until 3 paying cafes are on monthly retainers — founder edits using CapCut and Claude until revenue covers it.

stack.name: VN Video Editor
stack.why: Free mobile editor with no watermark and 9:16 export; founder edits reels between classes on a phone in India.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Free app for sending draft MP4s, collecting feedback and coordinating shoot timings with cafe owners.

stack.name: Google Drive
stack.why: Free tier stores raw footage, final MP4s and captions per cafe in a shared folder.

stack.name: Google Sites
stack.why: Free one-page portfolio showing 3 reel samples and packages, shared as a link in DMs.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Payment links for UPI collection of monthly packages; 2% + GST only after first payment.

stack.name: Notion
stack.why: Free student plan tracks shoot schedule, per-cafe deliverables and reel pipeline in one table.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Free tier writes reel hooks, scripts, captions and cafe-specific proposal text in Hinglish.

ai_tools.name: Whisper
ai_tools.why: Open source, free; auto-generates burned-in captions from voiceover audio for reels.

ai_tools.name: FFmpeg
ai_tools.why: Open source, free; trims clips, normalises audio and exports 9:16 MP4s in batch.

ai_tools.name: HyperFrames
ai_tools.why: Open source, free; Claude Code renders captioned 9:16 clips from HTML templates for batch reels.

mvp_features: Starter Reel Pack: 4 reels/month, one 60-minute on-site shoot at the cafe, 2 revisions per reel, captions + hashtags, delivered as MP4 via WhatsApp.
Growth Reel Pack: 8 reels/month, two on-site shoots, 3 revisions per reel, 8 caption variants, weekly delivery every Monday 10am, story-ready versions.
Trial Pilot: 2 reels for one discounted payment, shot and delivered within 7 days, converts to Starter Pack.

tool_costs.price_note: 2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/

first_10_steps: Walk 3 km around campus this weekend and list 15 cafes with seat count, Instagram handle and owner name in Notion.
Pick one niche cafe segment (cafes with 10-40 seats and under 500 Instagram followers) and shortlist 5 target owners.
Shoot 2 spec reels at a batchmate's cafe using VN Video Editor, export 9:16 MP4 with Whisper captions, post to your Instagram as portfolio.
Build a Google Sites one-page portfolio with those 2 reels, package list and WhatsApp contact link; buy a ₹75/mo .in domain.
Write a one-page proposal and 1-page contract in Claude (deliverables, 4 reels/month, revision limit, payment terms) and get it reviewed by a senior.
DM and walk into 5 shortlisted cafes offering a Trial Pilot (2 reels, discounted) with the portfolio link; book 2 pilots.
Set up a Razorpay account and create two payment links (Trial Pilot, Starter Pack) for UPI collection.
Shoot and deliver both pilot reels within 7 days; ask each owner for a testimonial line and permission to use the reel publicly.
Convert pilot 1 to Starter Pack by sending the monthly proposal and Razorpay payment link on WhatsApp.
Line up 1 freelance editor on Fiverr India as overflow backup and agree a per-reel rate before taking on a third cafe.

pricing.name: Starter Reel Pack
features: Captions and hashtags, MP4 via WhatsApp

pricing.name: Growth Reel Pack
features: 8 caption variants, weekly Monday 10am delivery, story-ready versions

revenue_targets.notes: One converted Trial Pilot on Starter Pack; second pilot in delivery.
Two Starter plus one Growth cafe on monthly retainer.
Three Starter plus two Growth; overflow editor covered by margin.

key_assumptions: Dehradun cafe owners will pay ₹4,000-₹7,500 monthly for consistent reels, assuming a local agency quotes ₹15,000+ on a 3-month retainer.
Delivery cost of ₹600/customer covers 2 hours of a Fiverr India overflow editor at ₹300/hour used on roughly one reel per customer per month.
Blended avg_revenue_per_customer of ₹4,500 assumes a 3:1 mix of Starter (₹4,000) and Growth (₹7,500) packs plus occasional one-time Trial Pilots.
Founder converts 1 of 2 Trial Pilots to a monthly pack within 30 days.

channels.name: Walk-in DMs to cafe owners on Instagram
channels.tactic: DM 15 cafe owners/day on Instagram with portfolio link and Trial Pilot offer; follow up on WhatsApp within 24 hours; 300 DMs/month.

channels.name: Campus WhatsApp groups + hostel notice boards
channels.tactic: Post 3x/week in 6 Dehradun college hostel/class WhatsApp groups offering a ₹1,500 Trial Pilot; print 50 A5 flyers at ₹4 each for 3 campus notice boards.

first_10_customers: Walk 3 km around campus, list 15 cafes in Notion with owner name, handle, seat count.
Shoot 2 spec reels free at a batchmate's cafe; post on your Instagram as portfolio.
DM all 15 owners the portfolio link + Trial Pilot offer; WhatsApp follow-up next day.
Book 3 Trial Pilots, deliver each within 7 days, ask for a one-line testimonial.
Convert pilot 1 and 2 to Starter Pack via Razorpay payment link on WhatsApp.
Ask each paying owner for 2 cafe-owner referrals in Dehradun; DM those 2 directly.
growth.cold_message: Hi [Name], I noticed [Cafe] posts rarely on Instagram — I edit reels for cafes near [Campus] and can shoot 2 sample reels at your cafe this week for ₹1,500. Portfolio: [link]. Want me to come by Tuesday?

objections.objection: I already have a nephew/ junior doing my Instagram for free.
objections.response: He'll stop during exams — I deliver 4 reels every month on a fixed Monday schedule, and you only pay after the first 2 reels are approved.

objections.objection: ₹4,000/month is too much for a small cafe.
objections.response: Start with the ₹1,500 Trial Pilot: 2 reels in 7 days, no monthly commitment — if they don't bring students in, you never pay again.

critic.verdict: The plan is a coherent, bootstrapped service business that stays true to the original idea of editing Instagram reels for cafes near campus in Dehradun, with realistic free tooling, campus-first channels, and a low-cost trial pilot. Pricing at ₹1,500-₹7,500/month is plausible for small Dehradun cafes if the founder can show local proof, and the 15-hour-a-week student constraint is respected through mobile editing and WhatsApp delivery. The main vulnerability is converting cold cafe owners into paying customers within 6 weeks without any track record or proof of footfall impact.
critic.biggest_risk: The founder has no portfolio, testimonials, or data proving reels bring students in, so cold DMs and walk-ins to cafe owners will mostly get ignored or deflected, and the 6-week first-customer goal slips.
